skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id one --wait
json-value id JOB
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
assert-output 0
assert-native 0
skygo --json jobs retention
json-value admin.obligations.0.id OBLIGATION
usage OUTPUT_BYTES PRESERVED
positive-env PRESERVED
stdout '"needs_manual": *true'
! stdout 'must-not-appear'
# This is the actual header created by metadata-only mark, not a forged row.
! skygo jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z
stderr .
skygo --json jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION
stdout '"selected": *1'
stdout '"executed": *false'
assert-output 0
skygo --json jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
await-output-usage 0
! exists $DATA/logs/$JOB.log
skygo --json jobs retention
stdout '"needs_manual": *true'
! stdout '"output_pending": *true'
! stdout 'must-not-appear'
! skygo jobs get $JOB
stderr 'result expired'
assert-native 0
